answer: To deter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can route trust through a decentralized interaction atlas. Nodes audit graph bottlenecks via random walks, forcing attackers to spend scarce bilateral reputation and real transaction fees to bridge honest cuts. Validated connections lock into a resilient crystal matrix, casting synthetic peer clusters into an opaque opal fringe. However, this approach delays onboarding for legitimate new agents and risks governance capture by early seed clusters.
